---
title: "Corrections and updates"
description: "Every value corrected after publication, with the before, the after and the reason."
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
erratas = d3.csv("../dados/erratas.csv")
versao = d3.json("../dados/versao.json")
```

Errors found after publication are fixed in a new dataset version and logged here. Analyses that quoted the number get a note. To report an error, [open an issue](https://github.com/contasemcampo/contasemcampo.github.io/issues).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
erratas.length === 0
  ? html`<p class="obs-vazio">No corrections published so far. Dataset ${versao.versao}, ${versao.data}.</p>`
  : Inputs.table(erratas.map(e => ({
      Version: e.versao, Table: e.tabela, "Club and year": e.clube_ano, Field: e.campo,
      Before: e.antes, After: e.depois, Reason: e.reason_en
    })), {rows: 20, layout: "auto"})
```
